correctness.rationale: Exact ray quadratic and strictly positive radical root. Symbolic identities yield ∂_t log r=-a/d and ∂_a∂_t log r=-d^{-3}; hence q and h are strictly comonotone decreasing in t for all a>0. The area-biased covariance formula proves strict growth of the fourth-to-second radial moment quotient for every real parameter. n-fold symmetry gives scalar covariance, and uniform limiting radial convergence gives the sharp endpoint. Green identities independently recover exact moments. The standalone checker verified 151 assertions but finite experiments are not substitutes for these analytical steps. Critical assumptions: The generating disk intersection contains the origin for all 0<=a<1.; The angular direction statistic t ranges in [cos(pi/n),1] and is nonconstant for every n>=3.; The covariance is scalar by rotational symmetry of order n>=3.; The strict logarithmic mixed derivative is -1/d^3 with d=sqrt(1-a^2(1-t^2)).; The uniform radial limit after dividing by 1-a is the inradius-one regular n-gon.

value.rationale: This gives a complete continuous classification of a canonical affine-geometric invariant for every regular array of at least three equal disks, with exact moments and two sharp extremal shapes. It is a motivated global deformation problem in disk-polygon geometry, not a finite table, routine rename or arbitrary narrow slice. The strict score-covariance argument extracts structural monotonicity not supplied by area-only treatments; no downstream grand theorem is claimed.
